verdict.rationale: Phaser has documented concept guides with code samples, full TypeScript definitions, a live llms.txt examples index backed by an examples API, and wide adoption (263k weekly npm downloads), all of which favour LLM familiarity. However, its own docs warn that Phaser 2 code found online likely won't work in Phaser 3, and the current release is 4.x, so model-seen examples risk being stale; community reports also criticise documentation quality. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence that LLM-generated Phaser code works first try, demonstrated API stability across major versions (2→3→4), and independent corroboration of current documentation quality.
